observations: Photo 0: A disassembled automatic transmission with torque converter detached, sitting on paving stones/bricks, dusty and visibly used.
Photo 0: A white label/sticker is visible on the transmission case with a partial number '460' legible, but the rest of the text is too small/blurred to read.
Photo 1: Close-up of the torque converter housing bell, showing wear, dried residue, and gasket surface; no fluid visible inside.

Photo 2: Wider shot of the transmission hanging/leaning against a wall, with dark fluid stains on the wall above it, suggesting a fluid leak at some point (either during storage or from the unit itself).
Watermark 'FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL LIMITED' overlaid on all three photos, consistent with a dealer/reseller branding, not proof of authenticity.
No VIN plate, no dyno/bench test, no video of the unit running or shifting is shown in any photo.

identity.kind: automatic transmission/gearbox assembly (seller claims Mercedes M278/722.9 'G63' fitment)

claims.claim: Transmission Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox
claims.evidence: No legible part/model plate in any photo confirms 'M278' or 'G63' fitment; text is seller-supplied, not read from an image.

claims.claim: 'Worked perfectly fine in...' (implying functional, recently removed from a running vehicle)
claims.evidence: No video, bench test, or fluid condition shot provided; stains in photo 2 could indicate leakage, not confirmed to be benign.

risks.risk: Internal condition (clutch packs, mechatronic unit, torque converter lock-up clutch) unknown; could be worn or damaged
risks.proof: Video of unit being hand-turned/bench-spun, or a dealer diagnostic/test-bench report

risks.risk: Part/model number cannot be confirmed as matching M278/G63 application; could be a different, lower-value variant
risks.proof: Close-up, in-focus photo of the ID tag/label on the case showing full part number
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic/unverified-model transmission, not as a confirmed G63-specific unit

risks.risk: Fluid leak evidence on the wall in photo 2 may indicate a seal or case leak
risks.proof: Close-up of the actual leak source on the transmission itself, and confirmation of fluid level/seal integrity
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming a leak is present, needing seal replacement

risks.risk: No mileage, vehicle history, or removal reason given; could have been pulled from an accident or failed unit
risks.proof: Photos of the donor vehicle, VIN, or removal documentation

proof_requests: Clear, well-lit, in-focus photo of the ID/part-number tag on the transmission case
Video of the torque converter and input shaft being manually rotated to check for binding/roughness
Close-up photo of the exact leak source and fluid color/condition
Any documentation or photos of the donor vehicle (VIN, mileage) this was removed from
response.reason: The claimed model (M278/G63) that would set the price cannot be read from any photo, and no evidence of working condition or leak-free state is shown, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without a legible ID tag and condition proof.
